intro.h2: Real woodworking, right on Frankstown Road
paragraphs: Modern Cabinet & Construction makes custom millwork in Altoona in its own woodshop, run from the green store at 110 Frankstown Rd. Mouldings are milled in oak, poplar, cherry, maple and walnut, and the store sells hardwood lumber surfaced on two or four sides.

The shop is known for the jobs a big box store cannot handle. One customer had Dan and the crew custom make a threshold between two floors at different levels and custom match vintage baseboard trim. Another got a tour from Ben and Dan and wrote that it was great to see craftsmanship is still alive. Google reviewers also mention a lot of hard to find items and stock products of better quality than Lowes for about the same price.

about.text: Modern Cabinet & Construction Company Inc works out of the bright green building at 110 Frankstown Rd in Altoona, Pennsylvania. Out front, the awning reads like a list of everything a woodworker or remodeler needs: cabinet hardware, hardwood flooring, stair parts, veneer, custom millwork, router bits, countertops, hardwoods, plywood and hardwood lumber. The company also runs a woodshop where mouldings are milled in oak, poplar, cherry, maple and walnut. Customers know Ben and Dan by name and say the crew is always knowledgeable and helpful. The store is open Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 4 PM.

image.alt: Modern Cabinet & Construction green storefront at 110 Frankstown Rd, Altoona, PA, with its product awning

steps.title: Call or stop in
steps.text: Call (814) 942-1000 or visit 110 Frankstown Rd on a weekday between 7:30 AM and 4 PM.

steps.title: Bring a sample or measurements
steps.text: Bring a piece of the trim you need matched, or the measurements and floor heights for a threshold or transition.

steps.title: Talk through the details
steps.text: The crew offers ideas and solutions. Share every detail of the job, since price depends on how complex the piece is.

steps.title: Milled in the shop
steps.text: Your moulding, trim or threshold is made in the woodshop in the hardwood you choose: oak, poplar, cherry, maple or walnut.

steps.title: Collect your order
steps.text: Pick up your finished pieces at the store, along with any stock trim, hardware or lumber you need to finish the job.

service_area.h2: Custom millwork in Altoona and nearby
service_area.text: Modern Cabinet & Construction serves customers from its store and woodshop at 110 Frankstown Rd in Altoona, Pennsylvania. Homeowners working on older houses, remodelers and woodworkers come in for custom mouldings, matched trim, hardwood lumber and cabinet hardware. If you are farther out and want to know whether a custom order makes sense for your job, call (814) 942-1000 on a weekday.

items.q: Can you match old trim in my house?
items.a: Yes. The shop has custom matched vintage baseboard trim for customers restoring older homes. Bring a sample piece or a clear profile to the store at 110 Frankstown Rd, and the crew can talk you through wood species, lengths and what it will take to mill it.

items.q: Which woods do you work with?
items.a: Custom mouldings are made in oak, poplar, cherry, maple and walnut. The store also sells hardwood lumber surfaced two sides (D2S) or four sides (D4S), plywood and veneer, so you can buy matching stock for the rest of your project.

items.q: Do you sell cabinets and countertops?
items.a: The store's awning lists countertops and cabinet hardware along with hardwood flooring and stair parts, and cabinets are in the company's name. Call (814) 942-1000 or stop in to ask what is available for your kitchen and how custom wood pieces from the shop can finish it off.

Modern Cabinet & Construction is open Monday through Friday from 7:30 AM to 4 PM and closed Saturday and Sunday. You can also email moderncabinet@atlanticbbn.net with photos or measurements of what you need, then follow up by phone during store hours.

items.q: How is a custom piece priced?
items.a: Price depends on the details: wood species, length, profile and how complex the job is. The shop has explained to customers that a quote for a simple piece changes once more complex details come in, so share every detail up front for the most accurate number.

final_cta.h2: Need a piece nobody else stocks?
final_cta.text: Call the Frankstown Rd shop or bring your sample in on a weekday.
